source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Classify a substance as acidic, basic, or neutral from paired blue-litmus and red-litmus responses.
node_labels: Matter: materials, particles, mixtures and change

intelligence.enrichment: Acidic samples make blue litmus red; basic samples make red litmus blue; neutral samples leave both litmus papers unchanged. substance_nature -> paired_litmus_response -> acid_base_neutral_label student says litmus paper just shows a colour but cannot say which observation decides acid or base

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 7 Science question. Chapter: Acids, bases and salts. The student must decide: Classify a substance as acidic, basic, or neutral from paired blue-litmus and red-litmus responses. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE. If the stem numbers activities 1..n, every number must appear in an option (or in a structured part's first-class options). Two-tier (choose, then reason) is welcome: put A/B/C on part.options, not typed into part text.
